offModel.testicular-artery-left: The testicular artery leaves the aorta just below the renal arteries; the model starts at the top of the abdominal aorta in view.
offModel.testicular-vein-left: The left testicular vein drains into the left renal vein.
offModel.penile-artery-left: The internal pudendal artery (from the internal iliac, through the pudendal canal to the root of the penis) is not in the model.
offModel.testicular-artery-right: The testicular artery leaves the aorta just below the renal arteries; the model starts at the top of the abdominal aorta in view.
offModel.testicular-vein-right: The right testicular vein drains into the inferior vena cava.
offModel.penile-artery-right: The internal pudendal artery (from the internal iliac, through the pudendal canal to the root of the penis) is not in the model.
